articles.title: What Your Ice Cream Flavor Says About You (Plus a 3,010-Pound Scoop!)
articles.summary: Did you know a scoop of ice cream once weighed more than a car? July is National Ice Cream Month, and we've got the sweet scoop on weird records, ancient treats, and what your favorite flavor might reveal about you.

articles.title: 39-Year-Old Novak Djokovic Wins Epic 5-Hour Tennis Battle!
articles.summary: At 39, Novak Djokovic played a five-hour tennis match and won! He beat a much younger player at Wimbledon. Even his opponent said, 'It's not normal.' Find out how he did it.

articles.title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce Say 'I Do' in a Lavender Haze at Madison Square Garden!
articles.summary: Pop star Taylor Swift and football player Travis Kelce got married in New York City! The wedding was at Madison Square Garden, and fans gathered outside to celebrate. Even the Empire State Building joined the party.
